name: disable_blocking_franchise_change_audit
statements:
-- Restore the original order-first write path. The audit table and its
-- immutable-record protection remain available, but audit capture must not
-- participate synchronously in business-critical order transactions.
drop trigger if exists capture_franchise_order_audit_trigger
  on public.franchise_orders

drop trigger if exists capture_franchise_order_item_audit_trigger
  on public.franchise_order_items

drop trigger if exists capture_franchise_order_adjustment_audit_trigger
  on public.franchise_order_adjustments

drop trigger if exists capture_franchise_order_product_audit_trigger
  on public.franchise_order_products

comment on table public.franchise_change_audits is
  'Immutable historical audit records. Synchronous capture is disabled so audit failures cannot block franchise ordering.'
